description: Full body chibi anime pixel art game sprite, 16-year-old young woman adventurer facing the viewer, standing straight, arms relaxed at sides, empty hands. Shoulder-length black hair with a short side braid, bright red-orange eyes, confident face. Simple beginner outfit: light grey cotton shirt, sleeveless brown travel jerkin, short red neck scarf, wide leather belt, dark navy-grey shorts over leggings, brown boots, cloth wrist wraps.

style_image.usage_description: Copy ONLY the drawing style: chibi anime proportions (big head, big eyes), crisp black pixel outline, shading and detail level. Do NOT copy the colors, hair or clothing — the new character must look like a different person.
